name: Nyúl (Hungary)
description: White field with a red horizontal stripe along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Nyúl: a quartered red, white and green shield with a bunch of grapes and a heart, with a helm, a crest and red, green and blue mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed NYÚL.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyúl arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
